meta.title: Flipkart Andheri East Atlas
meta.sub: Seven office options for Flipkart, read against the metro and the per seat rate
meta.sheet: Flipkart Property Inventory, Andheri East (Autopilot deck, Nov 2026). Positions and connectivity researched Nov 2026; each carries its source.

speed.note: TomTom Traffic Index 2025, Mumbai rush hour

hopsFromCentralLine.label: Metro hops from the Central Line

nextSteps: Confirm Privilon's carpet and built-up area, its floors and its January 2027 approvals with the landlord: the deck repeats 723 Avenue's figures.
Confirm the 220-seat ask and the two-hop commute rule, which come from the earlier brief and are not in the deck.
Walk the last stretch from the metro to 723 Avenue and Vaman Techno Centre: the sources give about 1 km and about 7 minutes.
Confirm Fulcrum's exact position; the pin is an estimate.

options.name: 723 Avenue
options.geoNote: Plus code 4V5M+VQM printed on the listing, decoded. Marol Co-operative Industrial Estate Road, off Andheri-Kurla Road.
options.reason: Priority 1 in the deck. Bareshell, immediate; 206 seats at 4x2, 14 short of the 220 ask. Metro: Marol Naka (Line 1 and Line 3), about 1 km on the developer's figure (540 m in a straight line from the pin).
options.address: Wadhwa 723 Avenue, Marol Co-operative Industrial Estate Road, Sag Baug, Marol, Andheri East, Mumbai 400059
options.metroWalk: about 1 km on the developer's figure (540 m in a straight line from the pin)

facts.v: Marol Naka (Line 1 and Line 3), about 1 km on the developer's figure (540 m in a straight line from the pin)
facts.note: The developer's brochure: '1 km away from Marol Naka Metro Station'.
From the deck: Flipkart Property Inventory, Andheri East (Autopilot deck, Nov 2026).

options.name: Corporate Avenue
options.geoNote: Map place page; Wikimapia outlines 'Corporate Avenue (Atul Projects)' 55 m away. Sonawala Road, off Andheri-Kurla Road.
options.reason: Priority 2 in the deck. Furnished, immediate; 225 seats at 4x2, 5 above the 220 ask. Metro: Western Express Highway and Gundavali, 650 m, 9 min walk; Chakala (J B Nagar) 850 m.
options.address: Corporate Avenue, Sonawala Road, off Andheri-Kurla Road, Chakala, Andheri East, Mumbai
options.metroWalk: 650 m, 9 min walk; Chakala (J B Nagar) 850 m

facts.v: Western Express Highway and Gundavali, 650 m, 9 min walk; Chakala (J B Nagar) 850 m
facts.note: myHQ lists Gundavali and WEH at 650 m (9 min) and Chakala J B Nagar at 850 m (11 min).
From the deck: Flipkart Property Inventory, Andheri East (Autopilot deck, Nov 2026).

options.name: Vaman Techno Centre
options.geoNote: Map place page. Makwana Road, Marol. About 460 m from Marol Naka station in a straight line.
options.reason: Bareshell, immediate; 223 seats at 4x2, 3 above the 220 ask. Metro: Marol Naka (Line 1 and Line 3), about 7 min walk.
options.address: Vaman Techno Centre, Makwana Road, Gamdevi, Marol, Andheri East, Mumbai 400059

facts.v: Marol Naka (Line 1 and Line 3), about 7 min walk
facts.note: Office Hub, for the Awfis centre in this building: Marol Naka metro, 7 minute walk. Awfis's own page says 0.30 km.
From the deck: Flipkart Property Inventory, Andheri East (Autopilot deck, Nov 2026).

facts.v: Rs. 5,000 per car park per month + Taxes

options.parkingCharges: Rs. 5,000 per car park per month + Taxes

flag.v: The deck says 'Marol Metro Station'. Listings put Marol Naka 0.3 km to 7 min away; confirm the walk on site.

options.name: Privilon
options.geoNote: The place page pin sits within 10 m of the Marol Naka station coordinate, so it marks the address, not a footprint. The developer says 'right next to Marol Metro Station'.
options.reason: Bareshell, available Jan 2027; 206 seats at 4x2, 14 short of the 220 ask. Metro: Marol Naka (Line 1 and Line 3), right next to the station.
options.address: Privilon, Metro Station Marol Naka, Gamdevi, Marol, Andheri East, Mumbai 400059

facts.v: Marol Naka (Line 1 and Line 3), right next to the station
facts.note: The developer: 'right next to Marol Metro Station'. OpenStreetMap puts Line 1 at about 0 m and Line 3 at about 100 m (mumbaipropertyexchange.com).
From the deck: Flipkart Property Inventory, Andheri East (Autopilot deck, Nov 2026).

flag.v: The deck gives Privilon the same carpet (11,331) and built-up (18,885) as 723 Avenue, and the floors only as 'Multiple'. Fire NOC, OC & CC and possession are Jan 2027. Confirm the area, the floors and the date with the landlord.

options.name: Landmark
options.geoNote: Map place page for Landmark, Suren Road, Gundavali, at the junction of the Western Express Highway and Andheri-Kurla Road.
options.reason: Furnished, immediate; 181 seats at 4x2, 39 short of the 220 ask. Metro: Western Express Highway (Line 1 and Line 7), about 200 m.
options.address: Landmark, Suren Road, Gundavali, Andheri East, Mumbai 400093

facts.v: Western Express Highway (Line 1 and Line 7), about 200 m
facts.note: JLL: 'just 200 metres from the Western Express Highway metro station'.
From the deck: Flipkart Property Inventory, Andheri East (Autopilot deck, Nov 2026).

options.name: Rustomjee Central Park
options.geoNote: Map place page; not the OSM 'Rustomjee' pin at 19.11642, 72.85428. Andheri-Kurla Road at the Chakala signal.
options.reason: Furnished, available Feb 2027 - Can be discussed for early vacancy; 163 seats at 4x2, 57 short of the 220 ask. Metro: Western Express Highway (Line 1 and Line 7), 3 min walk; Chakala (J B Nagar) 0.7 km.
options.address: Rustomjee Central Park, Andheri-Kurla Road, Chakala, Andheri East, Mumbai 400093
options.possession: Feb 2027 - Can be discussed for early vacancy
options.metroWalk: 3 min walk; Chakala (J B Nagar) 0.7 km

facts.v: Western Express Highway (Line 1 and Line 7), 3 min walk; Chakala (J B Nagar) 0.7 km
facts.note: The developer: 'The nearest metro stop, Western Express Highway, is a 3 min walk away'; Chakala Metro Station 0.7 km.
From the deck: Flipkart Property Inventory, Andheri East (Autopilot deck, Nov 2026).

options.name: Fulcrum
options.geoNote: An estimate. No map pin was found for the building; it adjoins the Hyatt Regency on IA Project Road, Sahar, so the pin is placed beside the hotel.
options.reason: Furnished, immediate; 212 seats at 4x2, 8 short of the 220 ask. Metro: Sahar Road (Line 3), about 690 m, measured from the Hyatt Regency next door.
options.address: Fulcrum, IA Project Road, Sahar Road, next to Hyatt Regency, Ashok Nagar, Andheri East, Mumbai 400099
options.metroWalk: about 690 m, measured from the Hyatt Regency next door

facts.v: Sahar Road (Line 3), about 690 m, measured from the Hyatt Regency next door
facts.note: Moovit: Sahar Road station is 687 m and a 9 min walk from the Hyatt Regency. Line 3 only, so a 3rd hop for Central Line riders.
From the deck: Flipkart Property Inventory, Andheri East (Autopilot deck, Nov 2026).

flag.v: The pin is an estimate beside the Hyatt Regency, and the building is a 3rd hop for Central Line riders.

lines.name: Metro Line 1 (Blue)
lines.note: Versova to Ghatkopar. Central Line riders change at Ghatkopar: the first hop.

lines.name: Metro Line 3 (Aqua)
lines.note: Underground, Aarey JVLR to Cuffe Parade. From Marol Naka a Central Line rider changes again: the third hop. The line is drawn straight between the stations shown, so it is indicative.
